title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Food isn’t easy to come by when you’re driving on desolate roads for hours on end. And in all honesty, you’ll be salivating over the landscapes a lot more than what you eat.
Be sure to carry some snacks with you when you fly into Iceland as even groceries can be sparse outside of the capital.
The Icelandic food we did try, the famous fermented shark (know as hákarl) was an acquired taste to say the least.
Surprisingly though, the best dal we’ve ever had in our lives (we’re from India!) was in Mama Reykjavik.
